beats.care: Avoid GN Road, Velachery Main Road and subways when it pours. Save your zone's GCC helpline number.
beats.what: Parry's Corner got 36 cm and Kathivakkam 34 cm in the 24 hours to Sunday morning. IMD issued a red alert for Chennai.
beats.why: The northeast monsoon is very active. More rain bands are expected over Tamil Nadu this week.

cards.body: GCC says all 22 subways were pumped out, and called the situation 'entirely under control'.
cards.caption: subways cleared and reopened by 6 am Sunday

cards.body: GN Road (T Nagar to Anna Salai), Velachery Main Road near Guru Nanak College, parts of Besant Nagar and Madipakkam, plus Perambur, Tiruvottiyur and Royapuram.
cards.title: Where water collected

cards.body: GCC has zone helplines from 94451 90001 to 94451 90015. Adyar is 94451 90013 and Sholinganallur is 94451 90015.
